tagline: Har web page ke peeche plain-text request aur response.
description: HTTP woh tarika hai jisse browser web server se page maangta hai aur server jawab deta hai. HTTP/1.1 plain text hai: ek request line, kuch headers, ek khaali line, aur optional body. Ek TCP connection kai requests ek ke baad ek carry kar sakta hai.
facts: CRLF par khatam hone wali plain text lines

normal.name: Page aur uska stylesheet load karna
normal.summary: Browser ek TCP connection kholta hai, HTML fetch karta hai, phir CSS file ke liye wahi connection reuse karta hai.

steps.title: TCP connection kholo
steps.detail: DNS example.com ko pehle hi 203.0.113.10 bana chuka hai. HTTP kuch bol sake, usse pehle browser ko port 80 par TCP connection chahiye, jo plain HTTP ka standard port hai. Isme ek round trip lagta hai.

quiz.q: Browser apne bilkul pehle packet mein GET request kyun nahi bhej sakta?
options: HTTP ko pehle TCP connection chahiye
Server ko pehle welcome message bhejna padta hai
quiz.why: HTTP/1.1 TCP ke upar chalta hai. Koi bhi request byte bhejne se pehle handshake poora hona zaroori hai.

steps.title: GET request bhejo
steps.desc: Request line aur headers, plain text mein
steps.detail: Browser apni request padhne layak text mein likhta hai. Pehli line mein GET, path / aur version hota hai. Har header ek Name: value line hai. Ek khaali line headers ko khatam karti hai; GET ki body nahi hoti.

quiz.q: Server ek IP address par 50 websites host karta hai. Use kaise pata chalta hai ki browser kaun si chahta hai?
options: Woh path se andaza lagata hai
quiz.why: Host header website ka naam batata hai. Isi se kai sites ek hi IP address share kar paati hain.

steps.title: HTML ke saath 200 OK
steps.desc: Status line, headers, khaali line, body
steps.detail: Server status 200 OK se jawab deta hai. Uske headers batate hain ki body HTML hai aur theek 248 bytes ki hai. Page khud khaali line ke baad aam text ki tarah aata hai. Browser segment ko ACK karta hai.

quiz.q: Is response ke baad connection khula rehta hai. Browser ko kaise pata chalta hai ki HTML poora aa gaya?
options: Server connection band kar deta hai
Woh Content-Length tak bytes ginta hai
Woh ek second wait karta hai
quiz.why: Content-Length browser ko bilkul batata hai ki body kahan khatam hoti hai, isliye wahi connection agla response carry kar sakta hai.

steps.title: HTML padho, CSS maango
steps.detail: HTML padhte waqt browser ko <link rel="stylesheet" href="/style.css"> milta hai. Kyunki server ne keep-alive kaha tha, woh doosri request usi TCP connection par bhejta hai. Naye handshake ki zaroorat nahi, jisse poora ek round trip bachta hai.

quiz.q: /style.css fetch karne ke liye browser agla kya bhejta hai?
options: Kuch nahi; CSS HTML ke andar thi
quiz.why: HTTP/1.1 default mein connection khula rakhta hai, isliye browser use turant reuse karta hai.

steps.title: Stylesheet ke saath 200 OK
steps.desc: Ek request, ek response, order mein
steps.detail: CSS Content-Type text/css ke saath wapas aati hai. HTTP/1.1 mein ek connection par responses bilkul usi order mein aate hain jis order mein requests bheji gayi thi. Browsers ek site ke liye 6 tak connections kholte hain taaki kai files ek saath fetch ho sakein.

steps.title: Browser render karta hai
steps.desc: HTML plus CSS se page banta hai
steps.detail: HTML aur uske stylesheet haath mein aane ke baad browser page banata hai aur screen par paint karta hai. Connection kuch der idle rehta hai agar aur requests aayein; server keep-alive timeout ke baad use band kar deta hai.

outro.title: Ek connection, do files
outro.text: Browser ne ek TCP connection khola, GET bheja, HTML ke saath 200 OK padha, aur stylesheet ke liye wahi connection reuse kiya. Har byte plain text tha, jo padhna aasaan hai aur raaste mein kisi ke liye bhi padhna aasaan hai, isi wajah se web HTTPS par chala gaya.

not-found.name: 404 Not Found
not-found.summary: Browser ek delete ho chuka page maangta hai; server status 404 se batata hai.

steps.title: Connect karo aur maango
steps.detail: Ek bookmark /old-page ki taraf point karta hai. Browser hamesha ki tarah port 80 se connect karta hai aur us path ke liye GET bhejta hai. Request mein kuch alag nahi dikhta.

steps.title: 404 Not Found
steps.desc: Us path par server ke paas kuch nahi hai
steps.detail: Server /old-page dhoondta hai aur kuch nahi milta, isliye status 404 se jawab deta hai. 404 bhi headers aur body ke saath ek poora, normal HTTP response hai; body wahi friendly error page hai jo tum dekhte ho.

quiz.q: Kaun sa status code family batata hai ki server khud fail hua, request nahi?
quiz.why: 4xx codes request ko galat batate hain (404 Not Found, 403 Forbidden). 5xx codes ka matlab hai server toota (500, 502, 503).

outro.title: Ek saaf error
outro.text: HTTP errors aam responses ki tarah travel karte hain. TCP connection theek hai aur reuse ho sakta hai; sirf status code batata hai ki kuch galat hua. Pehla digit batata hai ki galti kiski hai.

redirect.name: HTTPS par 301 redirect
redirect.summary: Koi https:// ke bina example.com type karta hai; server browser ko secure address par bhej deta hai.

steps.title: Pehle plain HTTP
steps.desc: Sirf naam type karne ka matlab http://
steps.detail: Jab tum bina scheme ke example.com type karte ho, to bahut se browsers pehle port 80 par plain http:// try karte hain. Request unencrypted jaati hai.

steps.title: 301 Moved Permanently
steps.detail: Server plain HTTP par page serve karne se mana kar deta hai. Woh 301 ke saath Location header se jawab deta hai jisme naya address hota hai. 301 ka matlab permanent hai, isliye browser use yaad rakh sakta hai aur agli baar HTTP step chhod sakta hai.

quiz.q: Location header padhne ke baad browser kya karega?
options: Port 443 par naya connection kholkar HTTPS use karega
Port 80 par wahi request dobara bhejega
quiz.why: Location ke saath 3xx browser ko wahan jaane ko kehta hai. https:// ka matlab port 443 par TLS hai, isliye naya TCP connection chahiye.

steps.title: HTTPS par jao
steps.detail: Browser port 443 par naya TCP connection kholta hai aur wahan TLS handshake shuru karega. Woh pehli plain request ek kamzor jagah hai: attacker use tamper kar sakta hai. HSTS isse theek karta hai, browser ko batakar ki ab se is site ke liye hamesha HTTPS use karo.

outro.title: Secure darwaze par bheja
outro.text: 301 redirect poora ek extra round trip leta hai aur pehli request ko unprotected chhod deta hai. Sites HTTPS par HSTS header bhejti hain, aur browsers preload list ke saath aate hain, isliye agli baar browser seedha https:// par jaata hai.

cheatsheet.title: Status codes
items: Ho gaya, bhejne ko kuch nahi
Tumhari cached copy abhi bhi theek hai
